The '''Galactic Trade Network''', or '''GTN''', was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] trading network that was active during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]]. It was accessed through [[Galactic Market Kiosk|Galactic Market Kiosks]], found in Galactic Trade Centers such as one in the [[Galactic Trade Center|Trade Market]] in [[Kaas City]], the [[Promenade]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] or in the [[Senate Commercial District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref>[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]</ref>
